def project_to_feasible(h, target_sum):
    """Project h onto feasible set {h: 0≤h[i]≤1, sum(h)=target_sum}"""
    current_sum = np.sum(h)
    scale = target_sum / current_sum if current_sum != 0 else 1.0
    h_scaled = h * scale
    h_clipped = np.clip(h_scaled, 0, 1)
    if np.count_nonzero((h_clipped < 0) | (h_clipped > 1)) == 0 and abs(np.sum(h_clipped) - target_sum) < 1e-12:
        return h_clipped
    
    diff = target_sum - np.sum(h_clipped)
    mask = (h_clipped > 0) if diff > 0 else (h_clipped < 1)
    available = np.sum(h_clipped[mask]) if diff > 0 else 2*diff
    h_normalized = h_clipped.copy()
    
    while abs(diff) > 1e-12 and not (mask.all() if diff>0 else not mask.any()):
        step = min(diff, 1e-4)
        h_normalized[mask] += (step / np.count_nonzero(mask)) if diff > 0 else -step/np.count_nonzero(mask)
        h_normalized = np.clip(h_normalized, 0, 1)
        diff = target_sum - np.sum(h_normalized)
        mask = (h_normalized > 0) if diff > 0 else (h_normalized < 1)
    return np.clip(h_normalized, 0, 1)

def mutate_with_balance(h, resolution_factor=1.2):
    """Evolutionary mutation preserving fitness characteristics"""
    n = len(h)
    # Two possible mutation paths
    if np.random.random() < 0.5:
        # Smooth variation
        noise = np.random.normal(scale=0.02, size=n) / resolution_factor
        new_h = h + noise
    else:
        # Targeted variation
        idxs = np.random.choice(n, min(50, n), replace=False)
        base_values = h[idxs]
        new_base = base_values + np.random.normal(scale=0.04)* (1-resolution_factor)
        new_h = h.copy()
        new_h[idxs] = new_base
    return project_to_feasible(new_h, n/2.0)
